text:
Phase 1 (`requirements_analysis`) is complete. The delta requirements have been written to `.sdlc/runs/20261104-170641-feature-extend-cross-step-conditional-fields/requirements.md`, covering:

- **In scope (1–7)** and **Out of scope (1–4)** bounded strictly to the Gate 0 28-path allowlist.
- **Functional requirements (FR-1 – FR-12)** across Step Schema Extraction & Hooks, Stepper Form Rendering/Validation/State Management, Review Step Schema Lookup & Display, Workflow/Template Editor Integration, and Documentation/Release Artifacts.
- **Non-functional requirements (NFR-1 – NFR-5)** covering backwards compatibility, RTL testing conventions, license headers, doc style guide compliance, and verification commands.
- **PII inventory** and **Role matrix** tables.
- **Executable acceptance criteria (AC-1 – AC-7)** and **Open questions for HITL** (none).
